UrlInput.name: setResult

VideoPlayer.name: emptyText

VideoUpload.description: Show a player instead of the file summary.

Workspace.name: barSize
Workspace.description: Thickness of every bar (any CSS length).

Workspace.name: basePath
Workspace.description: Base path relative tab routes are resolved against.

Workspace.name: children
Workspace.description: Main content (e.g. your router outlet / Next.js `children`).

Workspace.name: contentStyle
Workspace.description: Style for the `<main>` content region (e.g. padding).

Workspace.name: onAction
Workspace.description: Called for every tab activation (with or without route).

Workspace.name: onNavigate
Workspace.description: Navigate to a tab route (e.g. `router.push`). Without it, routes are reported via `onAction` only.

Workspace.name: onSidebarOpenChange
Workspace.description: Called when the workspace wants to close a sidebar (overlay backdrop click / Escape).

Workspace.name: overlayBreakpoint
Workspace.description: Below this workspace width (px) open sidebars float over the content as drawers with a backdrop instead of pushing it. `0` disables.

Workspace.name: sidebarWidth
Workspace.description: Width of both sidebars (any CSS length).

Workspace.name: skipLinkLabel
Workspace.description: Render a "Skip to content" link for keyboard users (`false` disables).

Workspace.name: topPrimaryStart
Workspace.description: Content prepended to the top-primary bar (e.g. the signed-in user's name).

YearPicker.name: color
YearPicker.description: Accent colour override (any CSS colour or `var(--irt-…)`).

YearPicker.name: compact

YearPicker.name: error

YearPicker.name: firstDayOfWeek

YearPicker.name: value
